name: Soybean Crush Spread — Processing Margin Monitor
description: CBOT board crush spread: 11 lbs oil × ZL/100 + 44 lbs meal × ZM/100 − ZS/100 (cents/bushel). Shows the soybean processing margin with 1-year z-score to identify historically rich/cheap levels. Uses NoAdjustment on all three contracts to preserve true cross-commodity price relationships. Includes 200-day MA overlay for trend context and event markers for z-score extremes (±2σ).
source:
# Soybean Crush Spread — CBOT Board Crush
# Formula: 11 lbs oil × ZL/100 + 44 lbs meal × ZM/100 − ZS/100
# All in cents/bushel. NoAdjustment per D16 for cross-commodity spread.

# --- Data: Load all three soybean complex contracts ---
zs_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zm_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()

# Continuation with NoAdjustment — preserves true price levels for spread calc
zs = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zs_raw.o, zs_raw.h, zs_raw.l, zs_raw.c, zs_raw.v, zs_raw.oi, zs_raw.s)

zm = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zm_raw.o, zm_raw.h, zm_raw.l, zm_raw.c, zm_raw.v, zm_raw.oi, zm_raw.s)

zl = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zl_raw.o, zl_raw.h, zl_raw.l, zl_raw.c, zl_raw.v, zl_raw.oi, zl_raw.s)

# --- Crush Spread Calculation ---
# CBOT board crush: 1 bushel soybeans (60 lbs) → 44 lbs meal + 11 lbs oil
# ZS: cents/bushel, ZM: $/short ton (2000 lbs), ZL: cents/lb
# Revenue: 11 × ZL/100 (oil, convert cents to $) + 44 × ZM/100 (meal, $/ton × lbs/100)
# Cost: ZS/100 (beans, convert cents to $)
# Result in $/bushel
oil_revenue = 11.0 * zl.c / 100.0
meal_revenue = 44.0 * zm.c / 100.0
bean_cost = zs.c / 100.0
crush_spread = oil_revenue + meal_revenue - bean_cost

# --- Analytics ---
# 200-day moving average for trend context
crush_ma200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(crush_spread)

# 252-day (1-year) z-score — is the margin historically rich or cheap?
crush_zscore = zscore(window=252)(crush_spread)

# Extreme z-score detection (±2σ)
is_rich = is_valid(crush_zscore) and crush_zscore > 2.0
is_cheap = is_valid(crush_zscore) and crush_zscore < -2.0
is_extreme = is_rich or is_cheap

# Label for event markers
extreme_label = "Rich (>2σ)" if is_rich else "Cheap (<-2σ)"

ts = index().value

# --- Output 1: Crush Spread Level with MA Overlay ---
# "Where is the processing margin and what's the trend?"
xy_lines(
    title='Soybean Crush Spread — Is the Margin Trending?',
    y_axis_label='Crush Spread ($/bushel)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='',
    category='Crush Spread',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Spread', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    overlay_series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='200-Day MA', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=crush_spread, overlays=crush_ma200)

# --- Output 2: Z-Score — Is the Margin Rich or Cheap? ---
# "How does today's margin compare to the last year?"
xy_lines(
    title='Is the Crush Margin Rich or Cheap? (1Y Z-Score)',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score (σ)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_axis_label='',
    category='Crush Spread',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Z-Score', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Fair Value'),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Rich (+2σ)'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Cheap (-2σ)')
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-2.0, to=2.0, color=Color.Blue, opacity=0.05)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=crush_zscore)

# --- Output 3: Summary Table — Key Stats ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Crush Spread',
    order=3,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Crush Spread Snapshot',
        row_size=2, col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Level', 'Z-Score'],
        col_headers=['Current', '1Y Average', '1Y Std Dev'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std,
                       type=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std,
                       type=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(crush_spread, crush_spread, crush_spread, crush_zscore, crush_zscore, crush_zscore)

# --- Event Markers: Z-Score Extremes ---
# Captures moments when the crush margin hits ±2σ — historically significant levels
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Crush Spread Extreme',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Regime', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Spread ($/bu)', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(crush_zscore, extreme_label, crush_spread, is_extreme)
